name: @gpters-internal/aitk
description: GPTers AI Toolkit CLI - MCP fallback & standalone CLI tool

scripts.build: bun build src/config.ts src/auth.ts src/client.ts src/output.ts src/commands/search.ts src/commands/get.ts src/commands/deploy.ts src/commands/updates.ts src/commands/report-session.ts src/commands/login.ts --outdir dist/src --target node --format esm && bun build bin/aitk.ts --outdir dist/bin --target node --format esm
scripts.dev: bun build bin/aitk.ts --outdir dist/bin --target node --format esm --watch
